title: Allow COOP `unsafe-inherit` to work with cross-site openers

labels.name: topic: cross-origin-opener-policy
labels.description: Issues and ideas around the new "inverse of rel=noopener" header

body:
In https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/4581, one thing that I missed in the transition from the original `cross-origin` idea to `unsafe-inherit` is what happens for cross-site openers with COOP.

Basically, we focused on two cases that should simultaneously work:

1. A **same-origin/site window with COOP** that opens a popup with `unsafe-inherit`.
2. A **cross-site window without COOP** that opens a popup with `unsafe-inherit`.

Currently, both of these are okay according to the [spec](https://gist.github.com/annevk/6f2dd8c79c77123f39797f6bdac43f3e) and FF implementation. Case 1 is fine when we copy over the COOP in 6.2 of the "obtain" algorithm, and Case 2 is fine because the original COOP is null.

However, it looks like we're not supporting the remaining case:

3. A **cross-site window with COOP** `same-origin/site unsafe-allow-outgoing` that opens a popup with `unsafe-inherit` (PoC: https://coop-checker.appspot.com/bug2/allow-outgoing-opener.html)

Here we want to allow the popup to be in the opener's browsing context group, because it opts into it and the opener has `unsafe-allow-outgoing`, and we're already allowing this when the opener doesn't have COOP -- so it doesn't reduce security over what we have now. However, copying over the COOP from a cross-site opener will result in a COOP mismatch in step 6 of the "match" algorithm because both windows will have COOP and they are cross-site.

This is something we should fix because it would prevent adoption of COOP on sites which open cross-site popups with `unsafe-inherit`, which we're hope to set e.g. for OAuth popups. Is there something we could do in step 6 of the algorithm (nsHttpChannel::ComputeCrossOriginOpenerPolicyMismatch in the FF implementation) to accommodate this case?

/cc @annevk @lweichselbaum @yutakahirano
